statement: Every countable nonabelian simple group E with a positive definite conjugation-invariant length having arbitrarily small nonidentity elements has an explicit unsolvable countable binary-tree system with identity exponent matrix. For every specified CW classifying space B of any group H, subgroup K<=H and epimorphism K->E, lifting this system gives an actual aspherical inclusion B->Y using countably many one- and two-cells, dimension at most max(dim B,2), H->pi1Y injective, all ordinary integral homology preserved, normal generation by H, and no pi1Y->E extending the specified map on K. Rerunning A28 with this fourth target class yields a new actual two-dimensional acyclic resolution BG^sharp->S^2 of size at most continuum with all A28 conclusions and no countable quotient in the fourth class.

notes: The first-changing-edge argument retains a nonconstant word image while excluding the next enumerated element. The symmetric normal set S_b={v[b,u]v^-1} has length at most 2 ell(b) and generates E; its Cartesian power supplies the required finite path. Coefficients are independent of the root variable, so every finite prefix collapses root-first to B wedged with frontier circles; this block needs no torsion-free hypothesis or Forester-Rourke theorem. The corollary explicitly reruns the A28 construction and names its new group G^sharp; it does not silently strengthen the previously constructed group. The left-invariant metric supplied by A29 is not assumed to satisfy conjugation invariance.
